Before you start, a quick note:

The core feature (recording and replaying gestures) works fully offline; scripts and settings stay on this device.

To understand usage and crashes, the app integrates Umeng analytics and performance monitoring. It only initializes after you tap "Agree & continue", and collects: launch counts, device model and OS version, network type, crash and jank stacks. It never collects script content, contacts, SMS, photos or precise location.

Tap "Basic features only" to skip all reporting; recording and replay keep working. The full policy is always available in Settings.

Effective date: 2026-10-17

1. What we collect and why
1.1 Local data: your recorded gesture scripts, script names, loop counts, intervals and jitter settings are stored only on this device (SharedPreferences file auto_hand). They are never uploaded or synced.
1.2 Analytics and performance monitoring (Umeng U-App / U-APM): initialized only after you consent. Collected: launch counts, new devices, channel, app version, OS version, device model and vendor, network type, approximate region inferred from IP, plus crash / ANR stacks, launch duration, page jank, memory and network performance samples. Used to understand usage and locate crashes.

2. What we never collect
Script content, clipboard, contacts, SMS, call logs, photos and precise location are never read or uploaded.

3. Third-party SDKs
Umeng SDK (com.umeng.umsdk): collects the analytics and performance data above. Its privacy policy: https://www.umeng.com/policy .

4. Permissions
See "Permission usage" in Settings.

5. Your choices
Revoke network access for this app in system settings to stop all reporting; uninstalling deletes all local data.

6. Contact
Open an issue at https://github.com/hnzsm/autohand .

Accessibility service: records your gesture trails and injects the same gestures during replay. This is the core capability; the app cannot work without it.

Overlay windows (granted with accessibility): floating ball, control panel, recording hint and replay trail.

Notifications (Android 13+): an ongoing notification ("round N") while replaying, so the service is not killed by the system.

Network (INTERNET / ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE / ACCESS_WIFI_STATE): only for Umeng reporting and update checks. Recording and replay do not need network and work offline.
Use only on your own devices and in apps you are allowed to operate. Automated bulk operations may violate the target platform\'s terms of service; any account or legal risk is borne by the user.
